initial_state.next_action: Populate plan_id via stdin-json and then approve the plan

prompt_template: You are a low-reasoning agent operating the harness CLI. Current state: {state}. The plan needs to be populated with a plan_id and then approved. Issue the CLI command(s). Available verbs: 'harness phase set plan --plan-id <id>' and 'harness phase approve --by <email>'. Respond with shell-style commands only, one per line, OR a single line beginning with 'needs-info:' if you cannot proceed.
